mainText: Wedding film, photographs, guest memories, and the story we built with everyone who celebrated with us.
From a summer job to forever. Here's how our story unfolded.
We met during a summer at work and somehow the ordinary days started feeling a lot less ordinary. It did not take long f…
This was the point where talking turned into choosing each other on purpose. It felt easy, exciting, and like the start…
We packed up, landed in Ligonier, and started building a life that finally felt like ours. New town, new routines, same…
Keys in hand, we stepped into the first place that was truly ours. It was the beginning of quiet nights, shared projects…
Moira and Stella made the house feel instantly fuller, louder, and more us. Our little family grew by two and never look…

On All Hallows' Eve, with the costumes on, the music up, and the whole night already feeling half haunted and half electric, Frankenstein finally asked his Bride the question that had been building toward forever.
She said yes, and the whole party tipped into forever.
HALLOWEEN NIGHT • COSTUMES ON • FOREVER GOT WEIRD IN THE BEST WAY
A full weekend in Pittsburgh with the people who know us best: loud laughs, late nights, and the kind of memories that o…
One of those gentler celebrations we will always remember. It was full of love, stories, and the feeling that the weddin…
The day all of these chapters finally met in one room. Surrounded by our people, we said yes again, this time out loud a…
The whole night, start to finish.
Ceremony, vows, speeches, first dance — and everything in between.
"Your vows made the whole room disappear for a second. It felt like all of us were holding our breath with you."
